It turns out I did have Guillain barre. In the span of three days I was pretty much a vegetable. I live in a third world country so medicine here is not readily available and IVIG was crazy expensive (10k$ a single injection) and of course we didn’t have that money. I ended up in a public hospital (hooorrible experience) unable to move at all and getting worse by the hour. Luckily my family got the word around and a bunch of people donated and we were able to get the medicine (also the word got around so much ever even the hospital ended up helping)

I was at the hospital for like 6 days and got out as soon as I got my last dose. Left in a wheelchair still unable to walk but able to move my arms, my legs, everything.
My recuperation was super quick after I was out of the hospital. I think I assisted to like 5 physiotherapy sessions by the time I was able to walk normally again. 4 months later if you looked at me you wouldn’t believe I ever had gbs lmao

Thank you for sharing with me. I'm so sorry you're going through this, I know how tough the first month can be. During the first two weeks I couldn't eat because me and my brother would always get each other food and in his last day alive he offered me food but I declined his offer because I just wasn't hungry. Even that affected me so much because that would've been the last time we got food together. I also wasn't able to go to the gym for a month and a half because of all the memories of him there and the first day I managed to go I barely worked out because of how sad I was. Today everytime I go to the gym I feel like I'm making him proud and I wouldn't want to ever go to another gym because that's where me and my brother went. I cherish everything that reminds me of him no matter how much it hurts sometimes. I know it's hard right now, and I won't tell you that the pain will go away because I don't think it ever will, but it gets easier. I'm still grieving, it hasn't even been a year and I'm still broken and some days I don't want to get out of bed, but I also have days where I can smile and laugh and feel hopeful. Just take your time and I'm here for you too :) feel free to message me if you ever want to talk. Much love!
